name: EREBUS
description: Erebus is Nyx's premium big brother, named after Nyx's partner in the myths. It keeps the black slot grille and coloured tubes, but goes upmarket: gloss black-chrome, chrome corners, pointed hex slots, a floating black-chrome EREBUS badge, a violet light line, a chrome lip and knobs with glowing violet pointers.
